findings.summary: The chosen Harel 'כללי' card was cut between screenshots, so its fee and share percentage can't be seen. The reader had to guess about 0.54–0.55%.
The '123 ממקור · 123 מחושב' legend and the dotted purple underlines are confusing; the reader doesn't see why it matters.
The 'מיון' (sort) box is cut off, so the reader can't tell how the list is sorted.
The explanations ('מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה', 'מה אומרים המספרים') are only links and can't be reached from the screenshots.
About 40 screens of nearly identical cards wore the reader out; they stopped reading each card around screen 25. There is no short side-by-side list of the 'כללי' tracks.
Tracks marked 'חדש' / 'עוד לא דווח' with the orange warning sign (and 0 million ₪) don't say whether something is wrong or the track is just new.
The round up-arrow button covers numbers the reader wanted to read (e.g. '0.5…' on screen 32).
The share and foreign-currency percentages add up to nearly 200%, and '101% מניות' appears; it isn't clear how these figures relate.
Track names ('סחיר', 'משולב סחיר', 'גמיש', 'עוקב מדדים', 'אשראי ואג"ח') aren't explained, so the reader can't tell, e.g., 'משולב סחיר' from 'כללי'.
It's unclear whether returns are before or after fees. There are no shekel figures (fee cost, a bad year's loss) and no worst-year or age-suitability risk information.
